Use case: stylized-concept. One individual Weisenfluh house warrior, full-body, transparent PNG, portrait 2:3. FIRST attached image is the binding PAINTING STYLE reference ONLY: gently simplified large clear shapes, matte muted colours, soft thin painted contours, restrained shading, fine uniform dry gouache pigment grain. Use its actual motif tastefully in embroidery, shield painting, clasps and restrained armour ornament, not literal impractical animal-shaped armour. Rich fine textiles and immaculate excellent armour, practical joints, believable straps and weapons. Vary pose and armour construction. Entire figure from highest helmet ornament to both boots, all weapon tips inside frame, at least 24px transparent margin. Where a horse is requested, show ENTIRE horse and all hooves as well as entire rider. Calm composed pose, no battle scene. True transparent exterior and open gaps, opaque painted figure. Ignore the aura in style reference: NO glow, halo, tinted fog, scenery, ground, cast shadow, pedestal, paper rectangle, text, labels, photorealism, CGI, thick comic outlines or extreme spikes.
HOUSE: goldkranz. CLASS: Landsprotektor.

Both hands resting on the pommel of a sheathed upright sword, heater shield at left resting on forearm with red/ivory chevron. Three-quarter left, relaxed gracious upright stance, not arrogant.
